limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments using the supplied screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and runtime account; no tools or additional files were inspected.
Equivalent normal, enlarged and transition variants are grouped by named screen/state; scores reflect the weakest material issue within each group.
The supplied runtime results are reported evidence, not independently rerun checks, and screenshots alone do not establish interaction behavior.
Browser scores use the full numeric range; no deduction is made solely for deferred physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, native sharing or native performance verification.
Connected Circles behavior, actual billing and real OS invitation/reminder delivery are not demonstrated; only the pictured offline, simulated and browser-fallback states are assessed.
Fixture wording and repeated synthetic passages were not treated as production-copy or model-quality failures.
Content extending outside a captured viewport is not assumed unreachable; reported scroll and reachability checks prevent treating these observations as proven hard-gate failures.
Filmstrips demonstrate sampled composition changes, not video smoothness or frame rate; performance evidence comes only from the supplied separate measurements.
Painted room destinations and contact shadows are visible, but independent depth layers, parallax and physically consistent moving reflections are not established by these captures.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence, but the authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components.
For each item, A and F are the means of their applicable dimensions and overall is 0.4A+0.6F rounded to one decimal; null denotes only a genuinely inapplicable dimension.
topFixes: Improve centered long-form reading through stronger prompt/answer hierarchy, shorter visual passage groups and consistent separators.
Reduce 200% vertical demand in check-in, profile, onboarding and plan layouts while preserving complete content and reachable actions.
Connect room transitions and the reveal payoff more convincingly through painted depth, contact lighting and coherent foreground/background handoffs.
Clarify scroll boundaries in long inputs and clearance above fixed footers.
Group equal-weight secondary actions and strengthen the opening affordance of history cards and room destinations.
